Syllables of one word are joined with hyphens, words are separated by spaces. Tones are not shown: see the pinyin (reading field) and the audio. Standard Mandarin, simplified characters.
reviewStatus: Written by rule from validated content; native English review recommended. Linguistic review required (tones, naturalness of phrasing).
title: Asking and negotiating
goal: Ask politely, express a condition and negotiate simply.

model.note: 您 (polite 'you') + 能 ('can, be able to') = the basic polite request; 可以 works too.

readiness: You can make a polite request (您能…吗, 我可以…吗, 能不能, 有没有可能), set a condition (如果… 就…), accept on a condition (要… 才行), decline with an explanation (不好意思，不行，因为…), apologize and offer to fix it (对不起，我马上…), and negotiate a price or a deadline.
